programme.title: 爆谷電影現場 第286集
programme.desc: 爆谷獨有電影大師組成的幕後精英超強班底, 每集全天候報導電影拍攝現場精彩過程, 獨家訪問, 第一次曝光電影片段。爆谷台瞭解任何一部電影的誕生, 都是幕前幕後眾多精英心血與智慧的結晶, 所以節目會以尋常角度看待所有工作人員如何齊心協力建造屬於他們自己的「夢工廠」。

programme.title: 走佬驚驚團
programme.desc: 一群無所事事的豬朋狗友, 有日突然中了彩票。 他們把這筆意外之財帶到賭場, 希望再將錢翻倍, 但最後卻負上了巨額債務。為了避債, 他們決定偷車逃走, 後來竟然發現車上有一具屍體?!突然變成了殺人嫌疑犯後, 他們的處境變得更加複雜︰既要逃過警方的追捕, 又要避過賭場老闆追數。究竟他們最後能否逃過兩大危機?

programme.title: 《一秒鐘》幕後紀錄片
programme.desc: 在物質匱乏的年代, 看電影就是一場狂歡, 每一段膠片都承載著一個夢。如今膠片時代已不復返, 張藝謀決定用電影《一秒鐘》為過去立傳, 給電影寫一封情書。為此, 張藝謀曾連續工作20個小時；張譯減重10公斤, 在敦煌沙漠接受暴曬；劇組人員在沙漠中拍一個鏡頭搬一次「家」；從三千人中脫穎而出的新晉「謀女郎」劉浩存潛心準備三年。本紀錄片將探索電影《一秒鐘》的幕後故事, 為觀眾帶來電影拍攝中的激情、感動與歡樂。

programme.title: 一秒鐘
programme.desc: 二十世紀七十年代, 看電影是人們重要的精神享受。西北某地, 張九聲因錯過了一場放映而悵然若失, 於是他想在電影的膠片裡找到對自己極為重要的「一秒鐘」影像。可惜追著電影而去的張九聲, 碰到了偷膠片的流浪兒劉閨女。終於在二分廠的電影院裡, 他倆與放映員范電影一起搶救了一場因膠片引發的放映事故, 三個互不相識的人也因為這場電影, 結下了一段不解之緣。

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: 爆谷獨有電影大師組成的幕後精英超強班底, 每集全天候報導電影拍攝現場精彩過程, 獨家訪問, 第一次曝光電影片段。爆谷台瞭解任何一部電影的誕生, 都是幕前幕後眾多精英心血與智慧的結晶, 所以節目會以尋常角度看待所有工作人員如何齊心協力建造屬於他們自己的「夢工廠」。

programme.title: 東京復仇者2 血腥萬聖節篇–命運

programme.title: 誰是兇手 第5集
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.title: 錯在新宿
programme.desc: 小男人阿寬與妻Ann復合後, 互相遷就, 再婚生活逐漸愜意。寬進公關公司任職, 認識了缺乏自信的女同事關之琳。見她終日冒冒失失, 更被追求不遂者捉挾, 寬於心不忍, 在工作上處處扶持。正因如此, 關對寬由同事之誼轉為男女之情, 剛好寬與Ann稍有磨擦, 寬轉而愛上了關, 更與關去日本公幹。此時, Ann遇上區議員朱君, 對朱頗有好感, 但Ann懸崖勒馬, 沒有動真情。返港後, 寬欲向Ann攤牌, 關竟搶著表示與寬只屬工作關係, 請Ann放心。關毅然斷絕與寬的感情關係, 令寬遭受打擊, 心情頹然。Ann得悉真相, 與寬決裂, 幾經糾纏、掙扎、衝突, 兩人竟又復合, 展開了另一段再婚又再婚的新婚生活。

programme.title: 虎度門
programme.desc: 粵劇名伶冷劍心為了把粵劇現代化, 請來林導演加入百老匯元素, 受到保守派排斥。另一方面, 劍心的丈夫決定移民, 劍心和女兒珊珊反對, 而女兒又被懷疑有同性戀傾向, 家人關係更加惡化。此時劍心在廿二年前於南洋誕下的私生子竟然出現眼前, 還跟劇團新進花旦葉玉媚相戀......

programme.title: 英雄好漢
programme.desc: 李阿擠是潮州大阿哥, 但他已經事業有成有妻有子, 開始討厭鎗林彈雨的生活；擠哥曾有兩名手下鄧家勇與陳定國, 定國是家勇父親吉叔養子, 二人本來情同手足, 但芋次事件中, 家勇與擠哥反目而定國隨即遠走馬六甲。擠哥與家勇大哥朱老大是生意上的拍擋, 朱老大以家勇逐漸失去控制, 想除去家勇卻反被家勇所殺。擠哥意圖與家勇和談反為所辱。家勇更進而調戲擠哥妻子, 定國得悉後從馬六甲趕回代擠哥向家勇求情, 家勇允之...

programme.title: 決戰紫禁之巔
programme.desc: 大內密探龍龍九奉命追捕鬼王七盜, 發現他是武當掌門凌雲鶴之化身, 在途中結識劍神西門吹雪。西門吹雪救了葉子青而相戀, 劍聖葉孤城向西門吹雪挑戰, 於九月十五日紫禁之巔比劍, 爭奪世上劍法第一, 御妹金燕子傾慕葉孤城, 欲阻止是次比劍。當中龍龍九識破此乃是刺殺皇上之陰謀...

programme.title: BEYOND日記之莫欺少年窮
programme.desc: 四個高中畢業、熱愛音樂青年, 各為自己目標奮鬥的故事。阿駒是一個為移民而與家人瘋狂搵錢的青年, 最後儲錢目標達到, 但因體力透支而病倒；阿強是一個有衝勁而頗有頭腦的青年人, 立志要創一番事業, 可惜誤入一間金融公司工作, 在上司設計之下連番受挫折, 最後連至親亦受牽連；阿中自小立志加入紀律部隊服務大眾, 但因身體潺弱, 未獲警隊接納, 索性加入交通督導員行列, 但因職責特殊, 對內對外均受極大壓力而深感痛苦；阿榮是一個勤奮而內向的學生, 一心入讀大學音樂系, 但在女友之父親諸多阻撓之下, 終於選讀入醫科...

programme.title: 把幸福拉近一點
programme.desc: 改編自一名「甘迺迪氏症」患者的真實故事。被母親拋棄的跳脫少女小菲, 遇上身患罕有病症的年青才俊子威並結下緣份。在為對方尋回失落的情人羨文同時, 竟發現子威久候治療疾病的新藥無效。然而生命影響生命, 雖然受到沉重打擊, 但重聚的三人決定將愛與希望延續下去。

programme.title: 大上海
programme.desc: 上海浦東長大的小子成大器, 在水果店工作, 勤懇好學。大器喜歡鄰居的京劇演員葉知秋。知秋自小漂亮出眾, 跟父親學刀馬旦, 一心在舞台上出人頭地。兩人青梅竹馬, 甚是甜蜜。可惜好景不常, 水果店老闆娘與警察局長私通, 卻被大器撞破。局長於是誣陷大器強姦老闆娘, 慘被判監。幸在獄中, 得到特務茅載救他脫險, 大器遂蒼皇逃走。葉知秋一直等不到大器消息, 只好隻身赴北京學藝。兩人從此失去聯絡。成大器在上海投向當時權傾一時的洪壽亭旗下, 任職打手, 被洪壽亭的妻子凌滬生慧眼賞識, 她也全力提拔成大器成為洪壽亭手下的第一紅人。成大器不贊成使用暴力, 他擅於談判, 願意利益共享, 往往能化干戈為玉帛...

programme.title: 真假佈局
programme.desc: 事業有成的企業家敏豪意外捲入一宗密室謀殺案。一天, 敏豪遭神秘人威脅要求公開婚外情, 騙他與情人世熙到酒店房間。他在房間被人突然擊昏, 醒來卻發現世熙伏屍在浴室內。案發現場無闖入痕跡, 門窗亦被鎖上, 所有證據都指向敏豪是兇手!為了打贏官司, 他聘請知名律師申愛為他洗脫嫌疑, 申愛要求敏豪必須對她坦白一切。在雪夜裡的深山別墅, 兩人開始抽絲剝繭拼湊出案情的始末, 卻沒想到在兇殺案背後, 隱藏著另一個陰謀...

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場 第286集
programme.desc: 爆谷獨有電影大師組成的幕後精英超強班底, 每集全天候報導電影拍攝現場精彩過程, 獨家訪問, 第一次曝光電影片段。爆谷台瞭解任何一部電影的誕生, 都是幕前幕後眾多精英心血與智慧的結晶, 所以節目會以尋常角度看待所有工作人員如何齊心協力建造屬於他們自己的「夢工廠」。

programme.title: 走佬驚驚團
programme.desc: 一群無所事事的豬朋狗友, 有日突然中了彩票。 他們把這筆意外之財帶到賭場, 希望再將錢翻倍, 但最後卻負上了巨額債務。為了避債, 他們決定偷車逃走, 後來竟然發現車上有一具屍體?!突然變成了殺人嫌疑犯後, 他們的處境變得更加複雜︰既要逃過警方的追捕, 又要避過賭場老闆追數。究竟他們最後能否逃過兩大危機?

programme.title: 《一秒鐘》幕後紀錄片
programme.desc: 在物質匱乏的年代, 看電影就是一場狂歡, 每一段膠片都承載著一個夢。如今膠片時代已不復返, 張藝謀決定用電影《一秒鐘》為過去立傳, 給電影寫一封情書。為此, 張藝謀曾連續工作20個小時；張譯減重10公斤, 在敦煌沙漠接受暴曬；劇組人員在沙漠中拍一個鏡頭搬一次「家」；從三千人中脫穎而出的新晉「謀女郎」劉浩存潛心準備三年。本紀錄片將探索電影《一秒鐘》的幕後故事, 為觀眾帶來電影拍攝中的激情、感動與歡樂。

programme.title: 一秒鐘
programme.desc: 二十世紀七十年代, 看電影是人們重要的精神享受。西北某地, 張九聲因錯過了一場放映而悵然若失, 於是他想在電影的膠片裡找到對自己極為重要的「一秒鐘」影像。可惜追著電影而去的張九聲, 碰到了偷膠片的流浪兒劉閨女。終於在二分廠的電影院裡, 他倆與放映員范電影一起搶救了一場因膠片引發的放映事故, 三個互不相識的人也因為這場電影, 結下了一段不解之緣。

programme.title: 誰是兇手 第5集
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.title: 錯在新宿
programme.desc: 小男人阿寬與妻Ann復合後, 互相遷就, 再婚生活逐漸愜意。寬進公關公司任職, 認識了缺乏自信的女同事關之琳。見她終日冒冒失失, 更被追求不遂者捉挾, 寬於心不忍, 在工作上處處扶持。正因如此, 關對寬由同事之誼轉為男女之情, 剛好寬與Ann稍有磨擦, 寬轉而愛上了關, 更與關去日本公幹。此時, Ann遇上區議員朱君, 對朱頗有好感, 但Ann懸崖勒馬, 沒有動真情。返港後, 寬欲向Ann攤牌, 關竟搶著表示與寬只屬工作關係, 請Ann放心。關毅然斷絕與寬的感情關係, 令寬遭受打擊, 心情頹然。Ann得悉真相, 與寬決裂, 幾經糾纏、掙扎、衝突, 兩人竟又復合, 展開了另一段再婚又再婚的新婚生活。

programme.title: 虎度門
programme.desc: 粵劇名伶冷劍心為了把粵劇現代化, 請來林導演加入百老匯元素, 受到保守派排斥。另一方面, 劍心的丈夫決定移民, 劍心和女兒珊珊反對, 而女兒又被懷疑有同性戀傾向, 家人關係更加惡化。此時劍心在廿二年前於南洋誕下的私生子竟然出現眼前, 還跟劇團新進花旦葉玉媚相戀......

programme.title: 英雄好漢
programme.desc: 李阿擠是潮州大阿哥, 但他已經事業有成有妻有子, 開始討厭鎗林彈雨的生活；擠哥曾有兩名手下鄧家勇與陳定國, 定國是家勇父親吉叔養子, 二人本來情同手足, 但芋次事件中, 家勇與擠哥反目而定國隨即遠走馬六甲。擠哥與家勇大哥朱老大是生意上的拍擋, 朱老大以家勇逐漸失去控制, 想除去家勇卻反被家勇所殺。擠哥意圖與家勇和談反為所辱。家勇更進而調戲擠哥妻子, 定國得悉後從馬六甲趕回代擠哥向家勇求情, 家勇允之...

programme.title: 決戰紫禁之巔
programme.desc: 大內密探龍龍九奉命追捕鬼王七盜, 發現他是武當掌門凌雲鶴之化身, 在途中結識劍神西門吹雪。西門吹雪救了葉子青而相戀, 劍聖葉孤城向西門吹雪挑戰, 於九月十五日紫禁之巔比劍, 爭奪世上劍法第一, 御妹金燕子傾慕葉孤城, 欲阻止是次比劍。當中龍龍九識破此乃是刺殺皇上之陰謀...

programme.title: BEYOND日記之莫欺少年窮
programme.desc: 四個高中畢業、熱愛音樂青年, 各為自己目標奮鬥的故事。阿駒是一個為移民而與家人瘋狂搵錢的青年, 最後儲錢目標達到, 但因體力透支而病倒；阿強是一個有衝勁而頗有頭腦的青年人, 立志要創一番事業, 可惜誤入一間金融公司工作, 在上司設計之下連番受挫折, 最後連至親亦受牽連；阿中自小立志加入紀律部隊服務大眾, 但因身體潺弱, 未獲警隊接納, 索性加入交通督導員行列, 但因職責特殊, 對內對外均受極大壓力而深感痛苦；阿榮是一個勤奮而內向的學生, 一心入讀大學音樂系, 但在女友之父親諸多阻撓之下, 終於選讀入醫科...

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Infos zur Serie:\n\nNeugierig, mutig und immer bereit für ein Abenteuer – das ist Dora! Gemeinsam mit ihrem besten Freund, dem Affen Boots, erkundet das clevere Mädchen die Welt und löst spannende Rätsel. Die interaktive Serie lädt kleine Zuschauer ein, mitzumachen, spielerisch neue Wörter zu lernen und knifflige Herausforderungen zu meistern. Perfekt für kleine Entdecker!

programme.title: Willkommen bei den Louds
programme.desc: Im Keller der Schule soll ein Rattenmonster leben. Das jedenfalls erzählen sich die Schüler und Schülerinnen seit Generationen. Als Stellas Spieluhr verschwindet, fällt der Verdacht sofort auf das Rattenmonster. Lincoln und Clyde finden im Haus der Louds niemanden.

programme.title: Die Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Infos zur Serie:\n\nIn dieser verrückten Show bekommt Patrick Star endlich seine eigene Bühne! Der liebenswerte, aber etwas chaotische Seeigel führt eine Talkshow, die genauso wild und unvorhersehbar ist wie er selbst. Mit seinen skurrilen Gästen, seinem schrägen Humor und jeder Menge Absurditäten wird die Show garantiert für Lacher sorgen – auch wenn nichts so läuft, wie es sollte!

programme.title: Die Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Start des zweiten „SpongeBob“-Spin-offs! Patrick, der beste Freund von SpongeBob, bekommt seine eigene TV-Show. — SpongeBob-Erfinder Stephen Hillenburg verstarb 2018. — 13 Folgen.

programme.desc: A french fry mascot needs help after being carried away by a flock of hungry seagulls; Mayor Humdinger tries to steal the Adventure Bay lighthouse.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.sub-title: Jungle Pups: Pups Save a Golden Sweetie; Jungle Pups: Pups Save the Giant Ants
programme.desc: The pups rescue Sweetie when she sneaks into the hidden jungle and finds a mysterious orb, which causes everything she touches to turn to gold; the pups must save a colony of giant ants from destroying the hidden jungle and themselves.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.sub-title: Pups Make a Splash; Pups Fall Festival
programme.desc: Ryder, Zuma, Skye and Rocky team up to save Cap'n Turbot's boat; the PAW Patrol must pick Farmer Yumi's fruit before an early snow storm.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.sub-title: Rescue Wheels: Pups Save Adventure Bay
programme.desc: Two competitive truckers come to town for a monster truck rally, one of them befriends the pups, the other stirs up lots of trouble.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.sub-title: Pups Save a Runaway Rooster; Pups Save a Snowbound Cow
programme.desc: Chickaletta and Roosterio run away from a chicken show and get stuck on top of a runaway drone. When Bettina wanders up Jake's mountain and gets caught in a snowstorm, it's up to the PAW Patrol to bring her safely down.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.sub-title: Liberty Makes a New Friend; Pups Save the Pup Pup Boogie Contest
programme.desc: Liberty mistakenly brings a bear into town, thinking it's someone's pet; she must fix her mistake and rescue Chickaletta; Francois' hot-air balloon goes out of control before the Pup Pup Boogie Contest; the Pups, with Liberty, race to the rescue.

programme.title: Minions
programme.desc: Evolving from single-celled yellow organisms at the dawn of time, Minions live to serve, but find themselves working for a continual series of unsuccessful masters, from T. Rex to Napoleon. Without a master to grovel for, the Minions fall into a deep depression. But one minion, Kevin, has a plan; accompanied by his pals Stuart and Bob, Kevin sets forth to find a new evil boss for his brethren to follow. Their search leads them to Scarlet Overkill, the world's first-ever super-villainess.

programme.desc: Grande Bob recibe un loro que finalmente se pone nervioso. Le pasa el pájaro a Helga, quien derrama sus emociones sobre Arnold al pájaro. Arnold y Gerald deciden vender tortugas de chocolate para recaudar dinero para el proyecto del club.

programme.title: ¡Oye Arnold!
programme.desc: Arnold se esfuerza al máximo para ganarse el afecto de Lila llevándola al Festival Anual del Queso. Harold siente que ha engordado demasiado, así que convence a sus padres de enviarlo a un crucero para perder peso.

programme.title: ¡Oye Arnold!
programme.sub-title: La ni˜ña modelo / Destruyendo a Arnold
programme.desc: Helga se convierte en la última estrella de la moda de infantil y todo el mundo ama a ella por su actitud gruñona y mala. La pandilla finalmente se cansa de los interminables buenos consejos de Arnold y deciden dejar de escucharlo.

programme.title: ¡Oye Arnold!
programme.desc: Cuando Arnold y el abuelo tienen un accidente con Helga y Grande Bob, surge una discusión sobre quién tiene la culpa. Después de un enfrentamiento en PS 118 entre Rhonda y Patty, ambos terminan en la misma escuela.

programme.title: ¡Oye Arnold!
programme.sub-title: El día de los veteranos, parte I / El día de los veteranos parte, parte II
programme.desc: Arnold y Gerald, y el abuelo y el padre de Gerald, visitan el monumento conmemorativo de un veterano. Ambos hombres mayores cuentan historias "altas" sobre sus hazañas militares que los chicos encuentran difícil de creer.

programme.title: ¡Oye Arnold!
programme.sub-title: De regreso en la escuela / La historia del huevo
programme.desc: El abuelo regresa a la escuela primaria, para que finalmente pueda cumplir su sueño de graduarse. El Sr. Simmons le da a la clase una tarea para emparejar y cuidar un huevo durante el fin de semana.

programme.title: ¡Oye Arnold!
programme.sub-title: El primo extra˜ño / El bebé Oskar
programme.desc: El primo raro de Arnold, Arnie, llega para una visita y parece ser el mayor perdedor para todos, excepto Lila. La esposa de Oskar, Susie, acepta cuidar al bebé de su primo, también llamado Oskar.

programme.title: ¡Oye Arnold!
programme.desc: Después de comer cortezas de cerdo, Helga comienza a caminar dormido y termina caminando hacia la casa de Arnold. El concurso de familias combatientes ha llegado a la ciudad y ha seleccionado dos familias.

programme.title: ¡Oye Arnold!
programme.sub-title: El hombre mono / Autobuses, bicicletas y subterráneo
programme.desc: Después de ser salvado de los matones por un misterioso personaje que se llama el hombre mono, Arnold le dice a la pandilla. En una excursión, Harold y Helga pierden el autobús y se separan del resto de la clase.

programme.title: ¡Oye Arnold!
programme.sub-title: La hermana del abuelo / Nado sincronizado
programme.desc: La hermana del abuelo, Mitzi, aparece de la nada para embellecer el hostal con su presencia. Cuando el entrenador Wittenberg necesita formar un equipo de nado para salvar su trabajo, recluta a Arnold.

programme.title: ¡Oye Arnold!
programme.sub-title: Helga como Layla / Señor Green candidato
programme.desc: Cuando Helga se da cuenta de que Arnold está tan tomado por Lila debido a su ingenio y encanto, decide que la única manera de hacer que Arnold le de atención es ser como Lila. Arnold ayuda al Sr. Green a postularse para el concejo municipal.

programme.title: ¡Oye Arnold!
programme.desc: Se recomienda a Helga para el asesoramiento después de que el Sr. Simmons observa su reprensión contra Arnold y discutiendo con sus padres. Ella aprende que el amor que no es correspondido es muy normal y que en realidad está bien.

programme.title: ¡Oye Arnold!
programme.sub-title: La muerte de Dino parte 1 / La muerte de Dino parte 2
programme.desc: Dino Spumoni finge su propia muerte para aumentar sus ventas de discos. Todo el mundo cree que está muerto y en el funeral, pero el abuelo y Arnold descubren que Dino le ha dejado a Arnold todas sus ventas futuras de discos.

programme.title: Bob l'éponge
programme.desc: Bob, une joyeuse éponge de mer, vit dans la jolie cité de Bikini Bottom, dans les profondeurs de l'océan Pacifique. Il est cuisinier dans le snack aquatique du capitaine Krabs. Sandy Ecureuil, championne de surf sous l'eau, et Patrick Etoile de mer sont ses meilleurs amis. Il n'a pour ennemis que Carlo Tentacule, un calamar désagréable, et Sheldon Plankton, un restaurateur rival, qui n'a de cesse

programme.desc: A vicious pirate group led by Pinkbeard who describes himself as one of Blackbeard's affiliates attacks a town in the Kingdom of Lulucia while their king and able-bodied soldiers have gone to the Reverie. And four bizarre individuals come to help.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Going into Action! The Implacable New Admiral of the Fleet - Sakazuki!
programme.desc: At New Marineford, Sakazuki, the new Admiral of the Fleet, hears the news about Luffy and recalls the tumultuous Paramount War that haunts the Navy! That game-changing war has repercussions that last into the present!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Paramount War! The Inherited Will of the King of the Pirates!
programme.desc: Nobles from around the world gather for the Reverie as the echoes of the Paramount War resound! Among them are Shirahoshi and her family from the Ryugu Kingdom under the sea. Meanwhile, Admiral Fujitora has a conversation with his new colleague.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: One Step Forward for Her Dream! Shirahoshi Goes Out in the Sun!
programme.desc: Stelly, Sabo's adopted brother and now the king of the Goa Kingdom, walks up to Garp who is escorting the royal family of the Fish-Man Island, with an air of importance and something up his sleeve.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: I Miss Him! Vivi and Rebecca's Sentiments!
programme.desc: Shirahoshi and her family finally reach the Holyland of Mariejois! But all the unexpected attention confuses her. Meanwhile, Vivi from Alabasta meets Leo and Rebecca from Dressrosa, and tells them the story of her journey with the Straw Hats.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: In the Dark Recesses of the Holyland! A Mysterious Giant Straw Hat!
programme.desc: Vivi reunites with Dalton and Dr. Kureha from the Sakura Kingdom and they share their memories of the Straw Hats with Shirahoshi and Rebecca. Meanwhile, a shadowy figure descends a long staircase at the castle in the Holyland and opens a mysterious door.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Holyland in Tumult! The Targeted Princess Shirahoshi!
programme.desc: Shirahoshi crosses the fancy of a Celestial Dragon, and those living gods are not open to having their whims disobeyed! As she is dragged away, King Neptune comes to her rescue, risking life and limb by defying the Celestial Dragon.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: An Explosive Situation! Two Emperors of the Sea Going After Luffy!
programme.desc: The Emperors of the Sea, Big Mom and Kaido decide to team up against Luffy! Meanwhile, Garp hears about the wild exploits of his grandson, all while a mysterious outsider visits the highest authority in the world!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Sabo Enraged! The Tragedy of the Revolutionary Army Officer Kuma!
programme.desc: After sneaking into the Land of the Gods, Sabo sees the shocking figure of his friend – Kuma! Abused by the World Government as a pawn in their games, Kuma, who was made an example of what happens when you disobey the gods!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Finally, It Starts! The Conspiracy-filled Reverie!
programme.desc: The Reverie has begun! The representative kings and queens first discuss what to do with Straw Hat Luffy. Meanwhile the Revolutionary Army confirms its desire to save Kuma! All while they recount how the Straw Hats have grown!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Marco! The Keeper of Whitebeard's Last Memento!
programme.desc: In order to recruit a strong ally towards bringing down Kaido, Cat Viper and his crew stop by Whitebeard's homeland to see Marco, the 1st division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Climbing Up a Waterfall! A Great Journey Through the Land of Wano's Sea Zone!
programme.desc: Luffy and the others become excited as they see familiar faces in a newspaper article about the Reverie while they close in on the Land of Wano. But this dangerous and foreboding land is as inaccessible as it is mysterious! The sea itself is a barrier!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Land of Wano! To the Samurai Country where Cherry Blossoms Flutter!
programme.desc: A mysterious country, a rampaging slasher, ancient samurai rituals of seppuku - and Zoro in the crosshairs! When a street assault occurs, all signs point to Zoro! Meanwhile, Luffy finally arrives at the Land of Wano.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Otama Appears! Luffy vs. Kaido's Army!
programme.desc: Stranded alone on the beach, Luffy tries to gather his bearings only to be confronted by some mysterious, and dangerous, local fauna! And then, he meets a little girl named Otama! Meanwhile, Zoro makes trouble for the others who are trying to blend in!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: He'll Come! The Legend of Ace in the Land of Wano!
programme.desc: Otama's gratitude towards Luffy knows no bounds! But the feast she cooks him exhausts her food stores completely! As she suffers from poor drinking water, her companion tells the story of the mysterious outsider she waits for - Ace!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Side Story! The World's Greatest Bounty Hunter, Cidre!
programme.desc: Ambushed and outgunned by a skilled bounty hunter Cidre's group, the Straw Hats rely on the Sunny's Coup de Burst to escape! But they end up stranded without cola! A nearby soda island offers a solution.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Side Story! Clash! Luffy vs. the King of Carbonation!
programme.desc: Luffy and Boa Hancock square off against the Cidre Guild! These unscrupulous bounty hunters have one thing in mind - profit at any cost! When the battle looks won, Cidre gears up in a menacing power suit!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Save Otama! Straw Hat, Bounding through the Wasteland!
programme.desc: Otama recounts her promise to Ace while Luffy rushes her to medical attention. But just as they reach the wasteland, a familiar face comes into view! But Kaido's underlings show up too!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Headliner! Hawkins the Magician Appears!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Defeat is Inevitable! The Strawman's Fierce Attack!
programme.desc: Luffy and Zoro have been stalled by Hawkins but their fortune looks bright as they are guided by a woman who Zoro had saved. She leads them to a teahouse and to an herbal remedy for the river poison.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Greatest Day of My Life! Otama and Her Sweet Red-bean Soup!
programme.desc: Otama's life is saved by Otsuru at her teahouse. The proud Otama finds it hard to take more kindness. The group learns of the Okobore Town - living on the cast-offs of the officials! Then, suddenly, they were attacked by the Shogun's men!

programme.title: One Piece

programme.desc: Otama has been kidnapped by the Gifters! She is taken to a flourishing town called Bakura Town where a creepy-looking Headliner was expecting her. Luffy and Zoro rush to rescue her along with a samurai, Okiku!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Yokozuna Appears! The Invincible Urashima Goes After Okiku!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Climactic Sumo Battle! Straw Hat vs. the Strongest Ever Yokozuna!
programme.desc: Luffy challenges Urashima, the strongest yokozuna in the Land of Wano, to a sumo match! Urashima even uses illegal moves to beat Luffy at any cost! Meanwhile, Holdem tells Otama that he knows she committed a crime and he has to punish her for it.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Luffy Rages! Rescue Otama from Danger!
programme.desc: After sending the yokozuna Urashima flying, Luffy and his clan continue their search for Bakura Town's boss to save Otama! They finally find the boss, Holdem, one of the Beast Pirates' Headliners.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Taking Back Otama! A Fierce Fight Against Holdem!
programme.desc: Facing Holdem who is holding Otama as hostage, Luffy prepares for a fight but Okiku tries to stop him by sharing who is really ruling the region. Meanwhile, Basil Hawkins is confronted by a mysterious figure.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Duel! The Magician and the Surgeon of Death!
programme.desc: Taking down Holdem, Luffy rescues Otama and tries to catch up to Zoro and Okiku who stole the food treasure ship and started a mad dash to get out of the town!

programme.desc: This is a story of Luffy in an alternate reality. While sailing on the sea by himself, a strange bird crashes into his small boat. He looks up to find a giant ship where a girl named Ann has been captured. It seems like the bird belongs to her.

programme.title: Two and a Half Men

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: Fußball: Bundesliga der Frauen
programme.desc: Die Frauen-Bundesliga ist die höchste Spielklasse im deutschen Fußball für jene, die sich selbst als Frau identifizieren. Etabliert wurde die Liga 1989 durch den DFB-Bundestag, im Jahr darauf wurde der Spielbetrieb in zwei Staffeln zu je zehn Mannschaften aufgenommen. Seit 1997 wird die Frauen-Bundesliga bundesweit nach dem Vorbild der Männer eingleisig, jedoch mit nur zwölf Mannschaften ausgetrag

programme.desc: M.Perry. Shefi i tij i ka ngarkuar një detyre: të mbaje nën vezhgim të dashuren e tij, sepse mendon se ai është homo. Oskari do te dashurohet me vajzen, por ështe i detyruar të vazhdoje të genjeje për të mos humbur atë dhe punen.

programme.title: Engjëjt e Çarlit 2
programme.desc: Treshja e mrekullueshme Cameron Diaz, Drew Barrymore dhe Lucy Liu rikthehet! Mjeshtret edhe kesaj radhe do te jene armike te betuara te krimit e padrejtesise.

programme.title: Sulm mbi Shtëpinë e Bardhë
programme.desc: Polici Xhon Keil çon vajzën e tij të vizitojë Shtëpinë e Bardhë, por pikërisht atë ditë një grup i armatosur sulmon gjithë kompleksin. Tani, Xhon është i vetmi që mund të shpëtojë presdentin, të bijën dhe kombin...

programme.title: Elisium
programme.desc: Matt Damon, Jodie Foster. Në vitin 2154, njerëzit e pasur jetojnë ne një stacion hapësinor luksoz, ndërsa pjesa tjetër jeton në Tokën e shkatërruar. Maksi, merr përsipër një mision të rrezikshëm, për të sjellë barazi midis dy botëve...

programme.title: S3E6 - Anger management
programme.desc: Ish-lojtari i bejsbollit Charlie është një terapist i menaxhimit të zemërimit me grupe të vogla në shtëpi. Ai ka një vajzë adoleshente OCD, një ish-grua dhe një mik/terapist seksi.

programme.title: S3E7 - Anger management
programme.desc: Ish-lojtari i bejsbollit Charlie është një terapist i menaxhimit të zemërimit me grupe të vogla në shtëpi. Ai ka një vajzë adoleshente OCD, një ish-grua dhe një mik/terapist seksi.

programme.desc: Ish-lojtari i bejsbollit Charlie është një terapist i menaxhimit të zemërimit me grupe të vogla në shtëpi. Ai ka një vajzë adoleshente OCD, një ish-grua dhe një mik/terapist seksi.

programme.title: S1E11 - Accused (Accused - US Format)
programme.desc: Kjo seri antologjike përmban 15 tregime intensive, aktuale dhe jashtëzakonisht njerëzore për krimin dhe dënimin. Çdo episod është një thriller i shpejtë dhe provokativ, që eksploron një krim të ndryshëm, në një qytet të ndryshëm, me një kastë aktorësh plotësisht origjinale.

programme.title: Kthimi i Supermenit
programme.desc: Brandon Routh, Kate Bosworth, Kevin Spacey. Pas një vizite të gjatë në atë ç’ka mbetur nga planti i tij Kripton, Supermeni rikthehet në Tokë, për të shpëtuar njerëzimin dhe dashurinë e tij...

programme.title: Riçi Riç
programme.desc: Kjo është shtepia e fëmijës më të pasur në botë. Ai ka gjithçka që do, me përjashtim të diçkaje që e dëshiron me shpirt. Por kur dikush tenton t’i vjedhë pasurinë Riçi bën çmos për ta shpëtuar duke zbuluar thesarin me të çmuar; miqësinë.

programme.title: Erdhi Zemëraku
programme.desc: Kjo është aventura e Territ, i cili është bllokuar në një nga përrallat që gjyshja e tij i tregonte i vogël... A do mundet dot ai të ndihmojë princeshën e përrallës, të shpëtojë mbretërinë?

programme.title: Komedianët
programme.desc: Adam Sandler, Seth Rogen. Jeta perfekte e aktorit komik Xhorxh Simons, tronditet nga lajmi i papritur i një sëmundjeje të pashërueshme. Pjesën e kohës që i ka mbetur do t’ia bëjë më të bukur një takim i rastësishëm me një aspirant komedie.

programme.title: Zoti Xhons
programme.desc: Zoti Xhons eshte nje njeri i cili i terheq te gjithe me energjine dhe sharmin e tij, por ai gjithashtu mund te bjere krejt papritur ne kriza te forta deshperimi e depresioni. Psikiatrija qe do te merret me te do ta gjeje veten te papergatitur.

programme.title: Prestigji
programme.desc: Bazuar në romanin e Christopher Priest. Nga regjisori Christopher Nolan. Me Hugh Jackman, Christian Bale, Michael Caine, Scarlett Johansson etj. Pasi një prej numrave të tyre magjikë përfundon tragjikisht, dy prestigjatorë të shekullit të 19-të, fillojnë mes tyre një rivalitet të egër dhe vdekjeprurës...

programme.title: Koleksionisti i kockave
programme.desc: Një ekspert kriminalistike (Denzel Washinton) dhe një detektive (Angelina Jolie) do të vihen në kërkim të një vrasësi serial dhe do të zbulojnë një të kaluar të errët.

programme.title: Wild Child
programme.desc: Dr.Gregori Hauz, një mjek rebel sjellja e të cilit shkon në kufijte e shoqërores, sfidohet nga të panjohurat mjekesore përpara të cilave mjeket e tjere dorezohen.

programme.title: Armiku tek porta
programme.desc: J.Law, E.Harris, R.Weisz. Një duel i pamëshirshëm mes një snajperi gjerman dhe atij më të mirit rus nën sfondin e betejës historike të Stalingradit. Beteja mes dy shteteve do të shndërrohet në një konflikt mes dy burrave...

programme.title: S1E10 - Accused (Accused - US Format)
programme.desc: Kjo seri antologjike përmban 15 tregime intensive, aktuale dhe jashtëzakonisht njerëzore për krimin dhe dënimin. Çdo episod është një thriller i shpejtë dhe provokativ, që eksploron një krim të ndryshëm, në një qytet të ndryshëm, me një kastë aktorësh plotësisht origjinale.

programme.title: S3E14 - Anger management
programme.desc: Ish-lojtari i bejsbollit Charlie është një terapist i menaxhimit të zemërimit me grupe të vogla në shtëpi. Ai ka një vajzë adoleshente OCD, një ish-grua dhe një mik/terapist seksi.

programme.title: Kthim në Shkollë
programme.desc: S’ka qene kurre nje vajze e hedhur. S’e ka ndjekur kurre moden dhe s’eshte konsideruar seksi. Tani eshte nje gazetare 25 vjeçare dhe i duhet te hiqet si nje adoleshente per t’i krijuar vetes nje mundesi te dyte per nje reputacion te ri.

programme.title: Gjëja më e ëmbël
programme.desc: C.Diaz, C.Applegate. Kristina Uolltersi ishte betuar se s’do të linte më asnjë mashkull t’i afrohej. Por pikërisht kur hoqi dorë nga dashuria, dashuria e gjeti atë. Por kësaj radhe rruga për tek mashkulli ideal është plot me surpriza.

programme.title: Familja Miçell kundra makinerive
programme.desc: Një apokalips robotik ndërpret udhëtimin e familjes Mitçell rreth e qark vendit. Tani, familja më e rrëmujshme dhe e pazakontë në botë, duhet të shpëtojë njerëzimin.

programme.title: Ishulli i Nimit
programme.desc: Jodie Foster, Gerard Butler, Abigail Breslin. Vogëlushja Nim jeton me të atin në një ishull të largët të Paqësorit. Kur babai I saj zhduket papritur, Nimi i kërkon ndihmë autores së romaneve të saj. Por shkrimtarja është në të vërtetë një njeri i pasigurtë që s’ka dalë kurrë nga shtëpia.

programme.title: Një letër për ty
programme.desc: Tom Hanks dhe Meg Rajan do të jenë protagonistë të një njohjeje të çuditshme. Armiq në botën reale, por dy shpirtra binjakë në atë virtuale. Të dy janë në biznesin e librit, por ai është i dhënë pas parasë, kurse ajo tepër sentimentale.

programme.title: Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & Emma Smith
programme.desc: One night only! Welcome to the spectacular and decadent world of The Babylon Hotel, where music pours out of every crevice like bubbling champagne. In this concert, the upper class meets the underworld in a melting pot of euphoria and extravagance, nostalgia and pleasure with a carefree sinfulness only seen in the exuberant nightlife of the 1920s around the world. The concert features iconic music from movies and series, such as The Great Gatsby, Burlesque, and Babylon Berlin. The music is performed by the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and DR Big Band under the direction of Miho Hazama. The concert also features the Moka Efti Orchestra, and singers Madame le Pustra, Emma Smith, Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch, and Nikko Weidemann, as well as dancers of Sweet Burlesque. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in May 2023.

programme.title: Isabel Schwartzbach, Eivør Pálsdóttir & Adam Riis
programme.desc: Explore the captivating sounds of epic gaming worlds brought to life by 150 musicians and singers at DR Koncerthuset. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by legendary video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, featuring Nordic vocalist Eivør as a special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

programme.title: Sarah Hicks, Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir & Tuva Semmingsen
programme.desc: This exclusive live concert production presents a unique selection of movie classics - from Sergio Leone's iconic Spaghetti Westerns to modern mafia masterpieces by Francis Ford Coppola and the cult movies of Tarantino. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir are conducted by Sarah Hicks in this premiere performance of authentic soundtracks by composer legends Ennio Morricone, Nino Rota, Sonny Bono, and Bernard Herrmann. Soloists for this performance are Tuva Semmingsen (mezzo), Christine Nonbo Andersen (soprano), Hans Ulrik (saxophone) and Mads Kjølby (guitars). Recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark in 2018.

programme.title: Christine Nonbo Andersen, Tuva Semmingsen, David Bateson & Steffen Bruun
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music. Under the direction of Dutch conductor Antony Hermus, the orchestra guides us through the musical universe, performing a selection of music from iconic sci-fi movies, such as Avatar, Gravity, Interstellar, and Star Wars, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, and James Horner. Featured soloists in this concert are Tuva Semmingsen, Christine Nonbo Andersen, Steffen Bruun, and David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August 2021.

programme.title: Sinne Eeg, Kristoffer Appel & Isabel Schwartzbach
programme.desc: The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies — to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune, and many more. Join the orchestra on the third and final symphonic journey through musical universes and cinematic galaxies — all the way to the outermost asteroids and back to Earth again.

programme.title: Les pouvoirs extraordinaires du corps humain
programme.desc: Expériences de mort imminente, sorties de corps ou encore médiumnité : les expériences de conscience modifiés fascinent les hommes depuis la nuit des temps. Certains de ces états, aujourd'hui mieux connus par la médecine, portent en eux des espoirs thérapeutiques révolutionnaires, notamment sur les plans de la lutte contre la dépression, le stress, les addictions ou les phobies.

programme.title: Les pouvoirs extraordinaires du corps humain
programme.desc: Le sport est bon pour la santé, c'est prouvé : pratiquer régulièrement une activité physique permet d'augmenter la durée de vie d'environ trois ans. Adriana Karembeu et Michel Cymès sillonnent la France et passent des tests pour évaluer leur condition, en compagnie d'experts et athlètes. Souplesse, puissance, rôle des muscles profonds, le corps est étudié sous tous les angles.

programme.title: Alerte enlèvement

Linda est censée patienter dans la salle d'attente, mais quand Aurélie sort du cabinet du médecin, la jeune fille et le bébé ont disparu. programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: C'est l'une des affaires criminelles les plus exceptionnelles de ces dernières années : le meurtre d'une jeune postière enceinte de cinq mois, Catherine Burgod, dans un petit village paisible de l'Ain en 2008. La violence du crime, la mise en examen de trois suspects très différents et la notoriété du suspect numéro 1 disparu, tout a concouru pour faire de cet homicide un cas hors du commun.

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: Le 25 octobre 1991, le corps de Marie-Claire Bego est découvert sur une berge de la Loire à Sauvigny-les-Bois. La jeune femme a été violée, étranglée puis brûlée. Après plusieurs investigations, un homme finit par avouer le meurtre avant de se rétracter. L'enquête se poursuit pendant des années.

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: En 1991, Marie-Hélène Audoye, 22 ans, disparait mystérieusement. Cette jeune représentante en produits pharmaceutiques a été vue pour la dernière fois dans une pharmacie de Monaco. Les investigations réalisées pour la retrouver ne donne rien. Et si la vérité était à chercher du côté de son petit ami ?

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: Le 13 octobre 1996, un membre de l'union sportive de l'arsenal maritime de Brest retrouve les corps de deux autres adhérents, criblés de balles. Il s'agit du technicien Paul Creton, et de François Picard, pharmacien chimiste. Depuis plus de quinze ans, les enquêteurs cherchent à résoudre cette affaire.

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: En 2011, le corps de Patricia Bouchon est découvert à Villematier, en Haute-Garonne. Cette mère de famille de 49 ans avait disparu depuis le 14 février. L'autopsie révèle qu'elle a été battue à mort et qu'elle n'a pas subi de violences sexuelles. Début 2014, son assassinat demeure non élucidé.

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: Le 2 novembre 2001, Eric Calers est raccompagné chez lui à Busnes, dans le Pas-de-Calais, par un collègue après sa journée de travail. programme.title: À la recherche de Pierre Richard

programme.desc: Ludwik ma coraz więcej zastrzeżeń co do zachowania Adeli, próbuje zdobyć dowody. Tomek stara się być samodzielnym ojcem, co nie kończy się dobrze. Załamana Magda znajduje wsparcie u Kuby. Paula pomaga Tomkowi w interesach. Kacper spędza z ojcem męski wieczór. Małżeństwo Boskich przeżywa wyjątkowo szczęśliwe chwile.

programme.title: Rodzinka.pl
programme.desc: Ludwik, ku wielkiemu zdziwieniu Natalii, zaprzyjaźnia się z sąsiadem. Kuba poznaje Filipa z Sonią, nie jest zadowolony z obrotu spraw. Majka czuje się zdradzona przez dziadunia. Marysia doradza Natalii, jak postępować z mężem.

programme.title: Świętokrzyskie krajobrazy
programme.desc: Filmowa podróż przez tytułowe świętokrzyskie krajobrazy tym razem skupia się na Sandomierzu i jego okolicach.

programme.title: UNESCO: Skarby Polski
programme.desc: Serial dokumentalny eksplorujący polskie obiekty wpisane na Listę Światowego Dziedzictwa UNESCO. W tym odcinku: obóz koncentracyjny Auschwitz - Birkenau.

programme.title: Makłowicz w podróży
programme.desc: Makłowicz podróżuje po Tunezji, a ściślej wokół miasta Monastyr. Ciekawy jest port rybacki Teboulba, z którego Robert wypływa kutrem, by zobaczyć hodowlę ryb na pełnym morzu.

programme.title: Słowo na niedzielę
programme.desc: Ewangelia o Sądzie Ostatecznym kieruje naszą uwagę nie na odczytywanie znaków końca świata, ale na to, jak żyjemy, jak traktujemy siebie i innych, jak "przygotowujemy" się na ten koniec. Na końcu czasów Chrystus przychodzi jako Król i Sędzia, ku zaskoczeniu ludzi stojących przed Nim. Przyczynkiem do rozmowy będzie cytat: "I zgromadzą się przed Nim wszystkie narody, a On oddzieli jednych ludzi od d

programme.title: Piłka nożna: Betclic 1. Liga
programme.desc: Betclic 1. Liga to 2. poziom rozgrywek ligowych w piłce nożnej w Polsce. Stawką rywalizacji jest awans do ekstraklasy, o który rywalizuje 18 drużyn. 2 najlepsze uzyskują awans do elity, a 4 kolejne uczestniczą w barażach o 1 miejsce.

programme.title: Komisarz Alex
programme.desc: Snajper strzela do ludzi na bazarze. Ginie mężczyzna badający aferę finansową. Odsunięta od śledztwa Monika prowadzi własne dochodzenie, które łączy się z jej przeszłością.

programme.title: Nic śmiesznego
programme.desc: Adam Miauczyński to reżyser filmów porno. Został nim w nadziei zdobycia sławy i bogactwa. Ale mija już czterdziestka, a jego marzeniom wciąż daleko do realizacji. Długi czas był tylko drugim reżyserem, na dodatek stale wyrzucanym z pracy.

programme.title: Archiwista
programme.desc: Henrykowi nie daje spokoju sprawa śmierci Bożyńskiego. Jego podejrzenia wzbudza lekarz, który wystawił akt zgonu. Kilka lat wcześniej był oskarżany o spowodowanie śmierci pacjenta, ale ostatecznie syn ofiary wycofał zarzuty.

programme.title: Archiwista
programme.desc: Późnym wieczorem mężczyzna przychodzi do znajomego, do domku letniskowego na wódkę. Zostaje ogłuszony przez gospodarza i utopiony w misce z wodą. Nazajutrz na komendzie zjawia Zenon Kurtyba, który twierdzi, że był świadkiem zbrodni.

programme.title: Ojciec Mateusz
programme.desc: W okolicach kościoła Natalia znajduje martwego mężczyznę. Okazuje się, że zmarł z wycieńczenia. W mieście niedawno została zamknięta noclegownia. W parku znaleziono kolejnego martwego mężczyznę. Sekcja wskazuje na zatrucie alkaloidem. Trop prowadzi do kościoła. Okazuje się, że ktoś chciał otruć księdza Mateusza.

programme.title: My, ewangelicy warszawscy
programme.desc: Ich początki w stolicy sięgają czasów, gdy ewangelicy reformowani nie mogli swobodnie spotykać się. Dzisiaj ta warszawska wspólnota ma już dwieście pięćdziesiąt lat. Jej historia jest również historią troski o drugiego człowieka...

programme.title: Gwiazdorska kuchnia Ani
programme.desc: W tym odcinku gościem Anny Strażyńskiej jest Alessandro Parrello.

programme.title: Blondynka
programme.desc: Na przystani w Majakach na kapitana czeka Jagna z rodziną. Kapitan ma przypłynąć stateczkiem, który będzie ich nowym domem. Sylwia towarzyszy przyjaciołom. Kapitan istotnie przypływa lecz nie statkiem turystycznym, ale łódeczką.

programme.title: Blondynka
programme.desc: Przez prześwietlone słońcem majakowe łąki idzie Auguścik, zbiera kwiaty. Bukiet przeznaczony jest dla Sylwii, która jeszcze tego samego dnia zostanie Kobietą Roku Podlasia.

programme.title: Zmiennicy
programme.desc: Znany reżyser Barewicz otrzymuje wiadomość, że na festiwalu filmowym w Berlinie Zachodnim przyznano mu Grand Prix i nagrodę rzeczową w postaci mercedesa. Natychmiast wyrusza na przejście graniczne po odbiór samochodu.

programme.title: Pan Mama
programme.desc: Bruno udaje przed dziewczyną, że jest piłkarzem, chociaż nie potrafi grać. Za to Zuza staje się cleanfluencerką, która nie potrafi sprzątać, a Maja wspomina przygody z mamą, w które nikt nie chce jej uwierzyć.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: W następstwie publikacji artykułu Weroniki, Borys występuje do pana Bogumiła z nową propozycją ugody, na którą mężczyzna przystaje. Rozmowa Huberta z Adamem przeradza się w otwarty konflikt, co budzi nieskrywaną satysfakcję Wilka i Lucyny.

programme.title: Niezwykłe miejsca

programme.title: Wojenne dziewczyny
programme.desc: Major Powała przesłuchuje Kamila Brodzkiego. Nie wierzy, że porucznik cierpi na całkowitą amnezję. Do pokoju wchodzi niespodziewanie Irka, podbiega do Kamila, lecz on jej nie poznaje. Irka ma żal do brata, że ukrywał przed nią prawdę.

programme.title: Dom
programme.desc: W kamienicy na Złotej pojawia się pierwszy telewizor. Szczęśliwymi posiadaczami są Wrotkowie. Andrzej i Wiktor chcą postawić na cmentarzu w Sierpuchowie pomnik upamiętniający walkę i śmierć ich przyjaciół z AK.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Poison is the subtlest form of death, and investigators must see through unusual circumstances to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: George Orwell's concept of Big Brother remains in the realm of fiction. But as technology becomes more a part of our lives, it's becoming increasingly more difficult to make a move without leaving behind an electronic trace.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Sometimes, the cause of death does not match the scene of the crime. When an untraceable poison is used to commit murder, homicide detectives turn to forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: For a price, anything's possible. Contract killings arose out of the need to establish the perfect alibi. By hiring someone else to do the dirty work, a person can deflect guilt, at least in theory.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: When lovers turn on each other, or marriages fail, some ruthless spouses find a grisly way to gain an uncontested divorce  with no paperwork. When murder tears lovers apart, forensic science must put piece together the mystery to catch the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Forensic psychologists delve into the minds of serial killers, explaining why, most often, they can be a friendly neighbor or the tenacious co-worker  the one who hides his or her dark side better than anyone else.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: When a victim is gunned down at point-blank range, police often assume that a friend or acquaintance is to blame.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: To the astute detective and forensic specialist, the biggest clues often hide in plain sight, and what seems trivial to some is in reality Critical Evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Identifying Burned Remains: It's difficult to have a murder investigation without a body, and burning up the victim is a time-honored method of destroying physical evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Ballistics: A corpse is found with a gunshot wound to the head; the weapon lies next to the victim. It looks like suicide, but could it be murder? It's a question best solved by ballistics experts.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: For some killers, murder can be a profitable business. And the scene of the crime can be both a source for clues, and puzzling questions. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must look beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: The tiniest residue left at the scene can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways.

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: Lady Gangster
programme.desc: Dot Burton wants to be an actress, but is stuck working as a decoy for bank robber Carey Wells and his crooks. After a big heist, Dot realizes that the boys plan to keep her share of the money. Angry at her partners and tired of crime, she hides the loot from Wells, intending to return it to the bank herself, but, before she can, she's thrown in jail for her involvement in the stickup. However, even the walls of a prison can't stop Wells from coming after Dot.

programme.title: Lady Scarface
programme.desc: A police detective (Dennis O'Keefe) and his photographer girlfriend (Frances Neal) hunt a gang led by a woman (Judith Anderson).

programme.title: Nora Prentiss
programme.desc: A successful and hardworking doctor, Richard Talbot (Kent Smith) strays from his marriage when he meets Nora Prentiss (Ann Sheridan), a beautiful nightclub performer. While Richard doesn't want to end his affair with Nora, he also can't face divorcing his wife (Rosemary DeCamp) and struggles to resolve his inner conflict. A surprising opportunity leads Richard to develop an unlikely plan that could allow him and Nora to run off together, but the scheme may not work out the way he intended.

programme.title: The Secret Garden
programme.desc: Orphaned Mary Lennox (Margaret O'Brien) arrives at the Yorkshire mansion of her mysterious Uncle Craven (Herbert Marshall). Bitter and confused after the death of her parents, she clashes with the other residents of the estate, including the surly housekeeper (Gladys Cooper), the giggling maid (Elsa Lanchester) and Craven's invalid son (Dean Stockwell). After discovering a key to a secret garden, Mary seeks the means to heal herself and the other inhabitants of the Craven household.

programme.title: The Great Sinner
programme.desc: When accomplished novelist Fedja becomes enamored of the stunningly beautiful and mysterious Pauline on a train to Paris, he abandons his plans and instead goes with her to a German casino. Fascinated by the people he meets there and wanting to remain near Pauline, he decides to study the gamblers as research for his next book. Pauline, however, is a consummate gambler herself, and her addiction slowly pulls Fedja into a world of corruption and lost luck.

programme.title: Marriage on the Rocks
programme.desc: An adman's (Frank Sinatra) wife (Deborah Kerr) winds up wed to his buddy (Dean Martin) after a quickie Mexican divorce and marriage.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Boys' Night Out
programme.desc: After seeing their boss with his mistress, four work friends (James Garner, Tony Randall, Howard Duff, Howard Morris) decide they should get a gentleman's pad in the city. When Fred (Garner), the only bachelor in the group, rents an apartment for their dalliances, he meets gorgeous Cathy (Kim Novak), whom he hires to be their "housekeeper." Cathy lets them all make plays for her, but has no intention of sleeping with them -- she is merely doing research for her sociology thesis.

programme.title: Incendiary Blonde
programme.desc: In 1909, lively Texas Guinan (Betty Hutton) attends a Wild West show and, dressing like a man, enters a bucking bronco contest and wins. Impressed by her audacity, the show's manager, Bill (Arturo de Córdova), hires her. In order to help support her family, Texas joins the rodeo and thrills the audience with her daredevil act. Texas and Bill soon fall in love, but Bill refuses to marry her, so Texas leaves the show for the bright lights of Broadway -- not realizing that Bill hides a secret.

programme.title: The Miracle of Morgan's Creek
programme.desc: In this wacky Preston Sturges comedy, the soldier-smitten Trudy Kockenlocker (Betty Hutton) discovers that she is both married and pregnant after a raucous troop send-off party. While she has no idea who her new husband is, her longtime admirer, Norval Jones (Eddie Bracken), seizes the opportunity to help. When Trudy's cop father (William Demarest) catches wind of the situation, however, wacky misunderstandings follow, with the well-meaning Norval on the wrong side of the law.

programme.title: The Enchanted Cottage
programme.desc: When a disabled World War I veteran moves to a small cottage, he meets a plain and kind woman.

programme.title: News From Home
programme.desc: Sweeping scenes of New York City contrasted to the letters from the director's mother in Brussels.

programme.title: Les rendez-vous d'Anna
programme.desc: Anna meets many people on her trip to Germany to show her latest film, and they all make personal revelations to her.

programme.title: Born to Kill
programme.desc: Drifter Sam Wild (Lawrence Tierney) murders a Reno, Nev., boardinghouse owner and her boyfriend in a fit of jealousy. Tenant Helen Brent (Claire Trevor) discovers the bodies, but instead of reporting the crime, she leaves for San Francisco as planned to return to her wealthy fiancé. On the same train, Sam flirts with Helen, then tracks her to her half-sister's house, where he continues to pursue her. Although Helen suspects Sam is a murderer, she inexplicably protects him from an investigator.

programme.title: D.O.A.
programme.desc: Frank Bigelow (Edmond O'Brien) is about to die, and he knows it. The accountant has been poisoned and has only 24 hours before the lethal concoction kills him. Determined to find out who his murderer is, Frank, with the help of his assistant and girlfriend, Paula (Pamela Britton), begins to trace back over his last steps. As he frantically tries to unravel the mystery behind his own impending demise, his sleuthing leads him to a group of crooked businessmen and another murder.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Race Street
programme.desc: After San Francisco bookie Hal Towers (Henry Morgan) refuses to pay syndicate protection money, his long-time friend, racketeer Dan Gannin (George Raft), finds him dead. Investigating the murder is another close friend, Detective Barney Runson (William Bendix), but Dan refuses to provide Runson with information. Investigating on his own, Dan is close to discovering the head of the syndicate -- only to learn his girlfriend, Robbie (Marilyn Maxwell), may somehow be involved with the organization.

programme.title: Woman on the Run
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, Frank Johnson goes on the run to avoid being killed himself. His wife, Eleanor (Ann Sheridan), seems almost apathetic about finding him when questioned by Investigator Harris (Robert Keith), due to a marriage on the rocks. However, after learning that Frank has a grave heart condition, Eleanor recruits reporter Dan Leggett (Dennis O'Keefe) to help track down Frank. Discovering new love for her husband along the way, Eleanor must get to Frank before the killer does.

programme.title: Impact
programme.desc: A declared-dead man (Brian Donlevy) hides out with a widow (Ella Raines) after his wife and her lover botch his murder.

programme.title: Blonde Ice
programme.desc: A society reporter (Leslie Brooks) kills men for fame and money, then tries to frame a sportswriter (Robert Paige).

programme.title: Dark Passage
programme.desc: Vincent Parry (Humphrey Bogart) has just escaped from prison after being locked up for a crime he did not commit -- murdering his wife. On the outside, Vincent finds that his face is betraying him, literally, so he finds a plastic surgery to give him new features. After getting a ride out of town from a stranger, Vincent crosses paths with a young woman (Lauren Bacall) who lets him stay in her apartment while he heals and continues to try and clear his name.

programme.title: The Maltese Falcon
programme.desc: In this noir classic, detective Sam Spade (Humphrey Bogart) gets more than he bargained for when he takes a case brought to him by a beautiful but secretive woman (Mary Astor). As soon as Miss Wonderly shows up, trouble follows as Sam's partner is murdered and Sam is accosted by a man (Peter Lorre) demanding he locate a valuable statuette. Sam, entangled in a dangerous web of crime and intrigue, soon realizes he must find the one thing they all seem to want: the bejeweled Maltese falcon.

programme.title: Stormy Weather
programme.desc: Bill Williamson (Bill Robinson), a struggling performer, meets a beautiful vocalist named Selina Rogers (Lena Horne). Bill promises her that they will be together after he becomes a success. However, he and Selina both skyrocket to fame and lose contact. Fortunately, Bill just might get one more chance to woo Selina at a huge musical stage show. Popular entertainers of the 1940s, including Fats Waller and Cab Calloway, perform as themselves in the film.

programme.title: A Song Is Born
programme.desc: A group of music professors, including Frisbee (Danny Kaye) and Magenbruch (Benny Goodman), are writing an encyclopedia of music. A pair of window washers introduces the duo to a pioneering musical form called jazz. Frisbee and Magenbruch start going to nightclubs to hear the new sound and become involved with club singer Honey Swanson (Virginia Mayo), who is running from police because they want her to inform on her gangster boyfriend, Tony Crow (Steve Cochran).

programme.title: Reveille With Beverly
programme.desc: As the substitute host on a morning radio program, former switchboard operator Beverly Ross (Ann Miller) becomes a local sensation when she changes the format to hot boogie-woogie. Wanting to meet the mysterious disc jockey, millionaire Barry Lang (William Wright) switches identities with his chauffeur, Andy Adams (Dick Purcell), so Barry can woo her without revealing his wealth. When Beverly's new job is jeopardized, they team up with soldiers at a nearby military base to save her show.

programme.title: Hollywood Hotel
programme.desc: After losing a coveted role in an upcoming film to another actress, screen queen Mona Marshall (Lola Lane) protests by refusing to appear at her current movie's premiere. Her agent discovers struggling actress Virginia Stanton (Rosemary Lane) -- an exact match for Mona -- and sends her to the premiere instead, with young musician Ronnie Bowers (Dick Powell). After various mishaps, including a case of mistaken identity, Ronnie and Virginia struggle to find success in Hollywood.

programme.title: Ship Ahoy
programme.desc: Tallulah Winters (Eleanor Powell), a Broadway dancer, is inadvertently involved in a spy plot when she agrees to carry a vital piece of equipment on a cruise to Rio. The spy ringleader got the idea of using an entertainer from a story by eccentric dime magazine writer Merton K. Kibble (Red Skelton) -- whose friend Skip Owens (Bert Lahr) has convinced him to take the cruise as well. Tallulah and Merton hit it off, until Tallulah overhears him discussing a plot for a story and thinks he is a spy.

programme.title: Du Barry Was a Lady
programme.desc: In this adaptation of a Cole Porter Broadway musical, star singer May wants to marry a rich man, but her heart belongs to a penniless dancer named Alec. Louis Blore, who has just won a fortune through the sweepstakes, promptly marries May. However, after Louis accidentally has a laced drink, he has a fantastic dream in which he, May and Alec are members of the royal French court. Once Louis awakens, he begins to reconsider his relationship with May.

programme.title: The Old Man and the Sea
programme.desc: An old Cuban fisherman (Spencer Tracy) has not caught anything in 84 days. Despite the devotion of the young boy (Felipe Pazos) who brings him coffee and food, the fisherman fears he has become perpetually unlucky. On his 85th day of fishing, the old man catches a small fish and decides to keep fishing. When one of his multiple fishing lines hooks a large marlin, he decides to not return to shore until he reels in the fish. For two days and nights, the man sits alone, waiting to redeem himself.

programme.title: Captains Courageous
programme.desc: When spoiled Harvey Cheyne (Freddie Bartholomew) is suspended from boarding school, his businessman father (Melvyn Douglas) takes him to Europe on a business trip. When the rebellious lad falls overboard from the steamship, he is saved from death by humble fisherman Manuel Fidello (Spencer Tracy) and forced by the captain of the fishing schooner (Lionel Barrymore) to become a low-ranking member of the ship's crew alongside the captain's own son (Mickey Rooney).

programme.title: Malaya
programme.desc: Soon after the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor, cynical former newspaper correspondent John Royer (James Stewart) devises a scheme with his old editor and government agents to return to the Far East and smuggle out a vast amount of rubber for the war effort. Demanding the freedom and company of his ex-friend, Carnahan (Spencer Tracy), whom he betrayed in an exposé years earlier, Royer sails off into the hands of the Japanese with a motley crew, gold and the promise of covert government aid.

programme.title: Northwest Passage
programme.desc: An epic Western, about Major Robert Rogers, the tough frontiersman who led a grueling expedition to Canada in 1759 to punish a fearsome Indian tribe and seek a northwest passage to the Pacific. Langdon Towne and Hunk Marriner joined the Rangers at the Indian village, but when they head on to Fort Wentworth, they find the place deserted.

programme.title: Terres de volcans

Récemment, le pays a repris le contrôle en créant à Buenos Aires son propre observatoire, l'OAVV. Le plus jeune du monde, il a pour mission de bâtir un réseau de surveillance moderne sur ce vaste territoire de 3700 kilomètres de long pour gérer ce risque majeur.

Кораловият град S1 E3 Кадри от Големия бариерен риф през есенния сезон, когато движението сред коралите се успокоява.
Кораловият град S1 E4 С настъпването на зимата животът на оживения риф се забавя. Рифови акули и октоподи бродят наоколо, а е показан и коралов оазис върху стар потънал кораб.

Спасяване на селски къщи с Пенелъпи Кийт S1 E5 В имението Треберфид в Уелс се състоява сватбата на годината. В Пичфорд Хол в Шропшър откриваме най-старата къщичка на дърво във Великобритания. Графинята на Мапъртън поема нови отговорности.

Спасяване на селски къщи с Пенелъпи Кийт S1 E6 Оранжерията в имението Айфърд в Уилтшър се обновява. На тавана в Чейвънидж е открит забележителен макет на железопътна линия. Започва реставрацията на историческата къщичка на дърво в Пичфорд Хол.

Откриване на изгубени зверове S2 E5 Трирогият трицератопс е ​​един от най-известните от всички динозаври и често изобразяван в битка с известен хищник: тиранозавъра. Дали тези два праисторически титана наистина са се борили помежду си?

Откриване на изгубени зверове S2 E6 Вълнестият носорог някога е бродил из Северна Европа - днес нови открития от вътрешността на пещера в Южна Англия разкриват какво всъщност е унищожило този могъщ представител на ледниковия период.
Леопарди - игра на тронове S1 E1 Една стара кралица на леопардите е мъртва; когато Танди, новата кралица, открива изоставените малки, започва битката за оцеляване и за короната на Джума.
Леопарди - игра на тронове S1 E2 Херцогът е тежко болен - нов мъжкар претендира за неговата територия и се опитва да убие младия Хосана и бебето Тлаламба.

Най-смъртоносните природни явления в света S2 E3 Две опустошителни земетресения удрят Мексико едно след друго, а австралийски преследвач на бури се озова в капан насред най-мощното торнадо, регистрирано някога в Ел Рино, Оклахома.

Гладиатори S1 E2 Австралия е земя, отделена от другите от времето на динозаврите; изолирана в продължение на милиони години, еволюцията е превърнала нейните животни в най-впечатляващите гладиатори на планетата.

Дълбините на Австралия S1 E2 Потопете се в хладните води край южния бряг, изправете се лице в лице с величествени сиви акули дойки, променящи формата си сепии и огромни сини китове и научете защо тези морета са пълни с живот.

Спящи гиганти: неспокойните вулкани на Европа Европа е дом на 100 активни вулкана. Вулканичните изригвания могат да се окажат пагубни за континента. Може ли Европа отново да стане жертва на голямо и опустошително вулканично изригване?

Гладиатори S1 E1 Сухият сезон затяга хватката си върху малък водоем в голямата савана на Южна Африка; тук група гладиатори - големи и малки - са събрани в опасна близост.
Речни Чудовища S3 E2 Джереми е по следите на мистериозен човекоядец. Дали звярът е само легенда, или е същество от кръв и плът, което е нападнало водолази, отвлякло е дете и е погълнало живи овце?

Ягуарски хроники S1 E1 Отправяме се към Пантанал с Лизи и екипа в търсенето на изчезнал доминиращ мъжки ягуар; станете свидетели на битката между него и други млади мъжкари, надяващи се да спечелят местните женски.

Вулканични острови: горяща заплаха Около 10% от световното население живее близо до един от 1500-те активни вулкана на Земята. Във френските задморски територии обсерватории наблюдават вулканичната активност, за да защитят населението.

Дивата Словакия с Найджъл Марвен Словакия има планини, увенчани с приказни замъци с гледка към могъщия Дунав. Опознайте природата на тази малка държава, дом на вълци, рисове, над 1500 кафяви мечки и други невероятни животни.

Йелоустоун: бомбата със закъснител на Америка Йелоустоун е един от най-мощните супервулкани на Земята. Какви биха били последствията, ако изригне? Водещи експерти ни показват различните възможни сценарии на суперизригване на Йелоустоун.

Речни Чудовища S3 E4 Джереми се отправя към отдалечена река в австралийската пустош, за да се опита да хване рядка, но страховита сладководна риба трион. Хищникът достига до 5.5 м. дължина и атакува лодки.

Дълбините на Австралия S1 E3 Посещаваме дивите земи, където пустинята на Австралия се среща с горещия и враждебен Индийски океан, докато биоложката Лизи Дейли се гмурка с тигрови акули, манти и номадски костенурки.

programme.desc: 經歷完9日精彩嘅夜生活，Yoshi同Anton決定要挑戰令人「心如止水」嘅釣魚Cafe，點知換嚟嘅竟然係一場釣魚釣到出晒汗嘅「動態冥想」？隨後兩位繼續保持興奮嘅心情，轉場去首爾最熱鬧嘅街頭宵夜處，感受布帳馬車嘅地道風味，Anton仲識咗位韓國小妹？去到旅程嘅最後，兩位仲快閃便利店互送禮物畀大家，究竟喺預算₩10000下佢哋買咗啲咩伏嘢？

programme.title: 擊戰 2 第13集
programme.desc: 四強台北集訓來到尾聲，決賽前終極考驗是到台北音樂搖籃Live House與樂隊進行Beyond金曲表演賽。合作單位是台北Beyond狂迷、專門表演Beyond廣東歌的貝斯手鍾小白。四強施展渾身解數，爭奪決賽福利。誰能獲得觀眾青睞，成為最終贏家？

programme.title: 大力情人 第10集
programme.desc: 決戰前夕，製作組特地為四對情侶準備了一個初心訓練營，在三日兩夜期間進行一連串修煉體能及愛情的項目，務求在終極大戰前讓他們重拾運動及彼此間的激情！

programme.title: 日本winwin企画 S2 第13集
programme.desc: 彈丸旅行解作快速小旅行，曾經乘坐夜巴痛苦體驗過彈丸旅行的Win Win，今集會以另一方式，徹夜從大阪前往九州別府，並以試瞓專員身份再次出動。

programme.title: 放浪美利堅 第1集
programme.desc: 夥拍導演攝影師，Chris 一行三人只帶背囊，開始美國野外之旅，第一站是美國至北至大的洲，阿拉斯加！他首先在阿拉斯加最大城市安克拉治 (Anchorage) 逛個「野性十足」的週日市集，然後就正式離開文明，走上馬塔奴斯卡冰川 (Matanuska Glacier) 探索！站在全美國可以揸車去到最大的冰川上，到底是什麼感覺？

programme.title: 救援小英雄珀利 5 第2集
放學玩啲咩 第37集
programme.desc: 連電視節目都特別舉辦爵士鼓比賽，可見這項樂器有多受歡迎。作為樂隊中不可或缺的核心樂器，一套爵士鼓究竟由哪些部分組成？不同位置所敲擊出的音色又有何差異？今集就帶大家一同深入了解。

programme.title: 大鳴大放 第1030集
programme.desc: 《大鳴大放》是一個30分鐘的時事討論節目，識英雄重英雄，請來各界重磅名人，拋出論點，言無不盡，深入討論時事，跨越維港神州，宏觀全世界。

programme.title: 經緯線 第532集
programme.desc: 專題式深入報道香港及世界熱門時事。

programme.title: 香港僱主聯合會呈獻: 解鎖好僱主 第3集
programme.desc: 人工高、福利好，就等於好僱主？其實一個真正的好僱主，除了給員工合理待遇之外, 還需要懂得關心員工、重視發展，同時打造理想的工作環境。《解鎖好僱主》走訪不同行業的優秀企業，透過管理層的真實分享，拆解成功企業背後的管理智慧，一齊發掘新時代的「好僱主」。

programme.title: 毛國界義工假期 第10集
programme.desc: Yoyo 繼續駐守巴蜀府狗狗救援中心，義工團體活動竟然是打泰拳？另一邊，Hailey 前往檳城貓沙灘，被超過30隻貓咪包圍，在陪伴中互相治癒。接著更到訪當地的「絕育先鋒」，與狗場負責人大談困難及願景。

programme.title: 我想身體健康 第147集
programme.desc: 長期不刷牙除了蛀牙口臭，原來有機會出人命？今集主持強尼、米露迪、Ash，找來Yoshi一起請教醫生！到底不刷牙為何會導致嚴重後果？

programme.title: 爆谷一周 第26集
programme.desc: 《爆谷一周》返嚟喇！作為全城最重磅影視娛樂訪談節目，今輯繼續為觀眾請來最新話題大作的焦點人物，盡訴幕後心中情，演員主創齊齊不設底線談天講地！除介紹令人翹首以待的首輪猛片，更有多集以香港影壇經典為主題，邀來各路影視英雄將影畫史娓娓道來，一同回顧經典，細述用無盡汗水鋪出的光影路！另設全新環節貼身追蹤電影生力軍嘅日常，了解他們不懈籌備新作的苦與樂！《爆谷一周》重裝上陣，共你一同穿梭香港電影的「現在」、「過去」與「未來」！

programme.title: FWD 富衛保險呈獻: CHILL CLUB 第332集 -嘉賓: RubberBand
programme.desc: 本集《CHILL CLUB》繼續請來 RubberBand，今集主題是「音樂路（下）」。人生有時需要向前，有時亦需要放慢腳步。RubberBand 透過新舊作品，與大家尋找屬於自己的生活節奏，探索人生的不同風景。此外，節目亦設有「CHILL CLUB 推介榜」，與樂迷一同公布本週第一至第十位推介歌曲。

programme.title: 蠟筆小新 第277集
programme.desc: 臼井儀人漫畫作品。五歲小孩野原新之助（小新）百厭趣怪，個性誇張自戀，是最令人頭痛的小朋友。小新與父親廣志、母親美冴、妹妹小葵住在埼玉縣的春日部市，最愛領著「雙葉幼稚園」的朋友你搞冒險，在日常生活中製造無數瘋狂趣事。

programme.title: SPY×FAMILY間諜家家酒 第三季 第44集
programme.desc: 伊甸學園的眾人被捲入了巴士劫持事件。周圍同學都嚇得發抖之際，安妮亞讀取了犯人的心思，得知巴士的目的地。在貝琪的機智幫助下，她們成功將求救訊息丟到車外。然而，可疑的舉動卻被劫匪發現，而將炸彈頸圈裝在安妮亞的頸上…

programme.desc: 四位潛水員均完成了不同的個人挑戰，節目的潛水旅程亦來到尾聲，他們的最後一次潛水將需要共同面對一個極度兇險的潛點挑戰——鯊魚風暴！一向懼怕鯊魚的Kylie更陷入崩潰，不停落淚，可能會導致無法反壓，令眾人憂心忡忡，到底最後大家能否成功最後一個潛水挑戰，為這個潛水旅程畫上圓滿的句號呢？

programme.title: MM730 - 困獸鬥 第30集
programme.desc: 相傳每年鬼門大開之日，各路鬼怪都要經歷重重難關，才可由陰間返回人間。6位扮演不同鬼怪的主持，要在萬聖節問答比賽「鬥智」之餘，亦要在身穿奇服、行動不便的情況下「鬥力」，在障礙賽中完成挑戰。到底誰可以在萬聖節「贏粒糖」，哪位卻要「輸間廠」?

programme.title: 環保發現號 第83集
programme.desc: 善用廚餘的概念除了在大學教學，還能如何讓小學生從小培養？今集繼續聽聽嘉賓的分享。

programme.title: 聲畫合拍 9 第16集
programme.desc: 《告別之前》講述鄉村清拆在即，在風和日麗的午後，芷晴與林婆婆各自面對著一場 告別。今集請來導演和歌手上來分享拍攝故事。

programme.title: 夜漫遊 第10集
programme.desc: 經歷完9日精彩嘅夜生活，Yoshi同Anton決定要挑戰令人「心如止水」嘅釣魚Cafe，點知換嚟嘅竟然係一場釣魚釣到出晒汗嘅「動態冥想」？隨後兩位繼續保持興奮嘅心情，轉場去首爾最熱鬧嘅街頭宵夜處，感受布帳馬車嘅地道風味，Anton仲識咗位韓國小妹？去到旅程嘅最後，兩位仲快閃便利店互送禮物畀大家，究竟喺預算₩10000下佢哋買咗啲咩伏嘢？

programme.title: 雙線運動人生 第67集
programme.desc: 《雙線運動人生》聚焦香港兼職運動員的故事。每集邀請一位從事普通職業、卻在閒暇投身運動的嘉賓，分享他們如何在繁忙的香港生活中平衡工作與熱情。他們用汗水與毅力詮釋「雙重身份」的精彩。節目呈現他們的起點、低谷與突破，探討時間管理、經濟壓力等挑戰，以及對夢想的執著。從日常訓練的堅持，到比賽中的難忘瞬間，觀眾將看到他們如何在快節奏的城市中為自己爭取一席之地。

programme.title: CSI: Miami

programme.title: 貨櫃大戰第2季:4
programme.desc: 該系列發生在商業航運港口，以一群來自不同背景的專家為中心，他們花費數万美元爭奪來自世界各地的高價航運集裝箱的內容。 由於只有幾分鐘的時間來評估集裝箱並決定是否出價，隨著他們大獲全勝或空手回家，壓力會越來越大。

programme.title: 心計第6季:14
programme.desc: 西蒙·貝克（Simon Baker）飾演派屈克·簡（Patrick Jane），一名受僱於加州調查局（California Bureau of Investigation，CBI）之獨立顧問。他利用出色的觀察技巧（如讀心術），成功偵破多宗大案。他過去經常使用所謂的心靈感應，曾假裝擁有通靈能力的靈媒而成名。派屈克·簡在一電視節目透露使用心靈感應協助警方調查連環殺手「紅約翰」（Red John），他的妻女因而被其殺害。在自責之下，他放棄作為騙人的靈媒，成為警方顧問。

programme.title: 卡那洛效應第3季:13
programme.desc: 麥可卡那洛是一個職業魔術師，卻是個愛開玩笑的人，他在一些很平常的場合裡，對一些猜想不到的人表演難解的魔術，全都被隱藏式攝影機拍下。

programme.title: 生活冷知識第2季:20
programme.desc: 歡迎來到由 Kevin Pereira 和 Brooke Van Poppelen 主持的每週節目，該節目以喜劇形式講述了永無止境的日常生活小貼士。 從學習如何用鞋子打開一瓶酒，到找出衛生紙捲的多種用途，永遠不乏有待發現的訣竅。 觀眾請注意：你們的生活將永遠不一樣。

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.sub-title: Hard Truths of Conservation - "The Aussie Way
programme.desc: The introduction of non-native species into Australia has had a large impact on native species. Ongoing management throughout the country is a daily task. Dan Cabela meets some of the people taking on this challenge.

programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor head deep into the Everglades to target snook in the murky waters of Lake Ingraham.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor use Lowrance Active Target all day to find fish, first targeting bridge tarpon then finding a variety of species in Florida Bay mullet muds.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors
programme.desc: While up in Alaska, the crew caught more fish than we had time to show so here's another look at some of the fish that were caught on the Alaskan trip.

programme.title: We Caught That
programme.desc: Capt. Jason Dozier and Janot take a break from the guided trips, and take themselves on a hunting adventure.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: When the yellowtail at the islands refuse to play, it's time to switch up the game plan. Ali and Rush pivot north of San Diego in search of hard-charging bluefin tuna during a multi-day mission aboard the 43' custom ACI Catamaran "Killer Bee". Armed with the right crew, the right gear, and a never-quit mindset, the guys roll the dice on an overnight move—hoping to wake up to redemption and put a few quality bluefin on deck.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Returning to Venice, Louisiana for the first time in nearly a decade, Rush reconnects with longtime friends Eric and Monique Newman of Journey South Outfitters for an unforgettable inshore fishing adventure in the heart of the Mississippi River Delta. With reports of massive schools of redfish cruising the beaches, Monique (“Moe”) must decide whether to trust the intel and make a bold run down the coast—or rely on her own instincts built from years on the water. The mission is simple: put Rush on a true bull redfish and see if he has what it takes to earn a spot in her coveted “Over 40-Inch Club.” This trip highlights why Venice, Louisiana is considered one of the premier inshore fisheries in the country—and why having the right guide makes all the difference. Target Species: Bull Redfish. Location: Venice, Louisiana – Mississippi Delta. Outfitter: Journey South Outfitters.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: We listen to guides and anglers on how they attempt to hook into the migrating tarpon that pass thru PCB's beautiful beach waters each summer. It's a lesson in humility, respect and yes....luck.

programme.title: Le lac d'Ohrid

Il abrite, sur un espace restreint, plus d'espèces que n'importe quel autre plan d'eau du continent. Ses fonds recèlent également des secrets archéologiques particulièrement éclairants sur l'histoire de l'implantation humaine en Europe.

Pour préserver leur mode de vie, les rares habitants doivent s'adapter aux changements qui se produisent aussi bien au-dessus qu'au-dessous de l'eau.

programme.title: Masters of the Universe
programme.desc: When the evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) finds a mysterious power called the Cosmic Key, he becomes nearly invincible. However, courageous warrior He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) locates inventor Gwildor (Billy Barty), who created the Key and has another version of it. During a battle, one of the Keys is transported to Earth, where it is found by teenagers Julie (Courteney Cox) and Kevin (Robert Duncan McNeill). Now both He-Man and Skeletor's forces arrive on Earth searching for the potent weapon.

programme.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
programme.desc: This remake of the classic horror film is set in San Francisco. Matthew Bennell assumes that when a friend complains of her husband's strange mood, it's a marital issue. However, he begins to worry as more people report similar observations. His concern is confirmed when writer Jack Bellicec and his wife discover a mutated corpse. Besieged by an invisible enemy, Bennell must work quickly before the city is consumed.

programme.title: Rise: Blood Hunter
programme.desc: Sadie (Lucy Liu), a reporter, investigates an underground cult in Los Angeles which seems to be responsible for a series of grisly murders. While trying to discover the cult's secrets, she becomes a victim herself. Sadie awakes in the morgue with an insatiable craving for blood and revenge, so she joins forces with a grieving detective (Michael Chiklis) to destroy the undead creatures once and for all.

programme.title: Sprova e familjes
programme.desc: Doan, një kirurg i suksesshëm që ka shpëtuar shumë jetë, por nuk ka mundur të shpëtojë të tijën. Ai u largua nga familja, nga dhimbja, nga kujtimet. Por disa plagë nuk shërohen kurrë. Çalla, një avokate e fortë, e vendosur dhe një grua që nuk i frikësohet së vërtetës. Kur familja bëhet sprova më e madhe, Doan duhet të zgjedhë: Të largohet apo të përballet me të vërtetën. programme.title: Mëkate dhe trëndafila
programme.desc: Një sekret i fshehur për vite me radhë. Një familje në prag të shkatërrimit. Dhe një dashuri që lind mes dhimbjes dhe së vërtetës. Çdo trëndafil fsheh një sekret dhe çdo mëkat ka një çmim. Ai besonte te familja. Ajo besonte te e vërteta. Por kur sekretet dalin në dritë, asgjë nuk mbetet si më parë. Dashuri, tradhti dhe emocione që sfidojnë fatin. Me aktoret e famshem: Cemre Baysel dhe Murat Yildirim.

programme.title: STOP
programme.desc: Aktualiteti shqiptar ”alla Stop”, problematika e njerëzve të thjeshtë, që pasi kanë trokitur në të gjitha dyert, gjejnë zgjidhje vetëm në ”Stop” , video-kamera të fshehta, që denoncojnë e demaskojnë korrupsionin, dhunën apo abuzimin seksual. Akte humanizmi për më të pamundurit e fatkeqët, të cilëve u ndryshon jeta. Nje emision i gjithi vetëm për njerëzit e zakonshëm dhe me njerëzit në qendër.

programme.title: Aldo Morning Show
programme.desc: Dielli lind ndryshe në TVKLAN, në 7 pa 1 minutë! Të lodhur apo të palodhur nga gjumi i natës, nga e djeshmja me halle e strese, Aldo ju fton të zgjohemi me buzeqeshje, me qeshje, me nënqeshje, dhe më kryesorja. me një adrenaline të paparë për ta nisu.

programme.title: Shije Shtepie
programme.desc: Emision edukues - informues - argetues me zn.Tefta dhe Katerina Trungu. Cdo ditë me recetat e thjeshta dhe mbi te gjitha ekonomike te Zj.Vjollca duke edukuar amvisat si te ushqehemi shëndetshëm. Rubrika te ndryshme me te ftuar speciale me këshilla te thjeshta praktike, të kuptueshme nga te gjithë, për cdo aspekt të të përditshmes.

programme.title: Shtëpiake të dëshpëruara
programme.desc: Komedia me skenarin me te mire te pershtatur nga versioni amerikan. Jeta dhe dashurite e pese heroinave te serialit qe jetojne ne rrugicen ”Trendafil”: Jasemin, Nermin, Zelish, Elif dhe Emel.

programme.title: Lajme
programme.desc: Lajme nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: NEHIR
programme.desc: Ndertimi i nje dige do te shnderrohet ne nje vend ku dashuria ”permbyt” gjithçka. E gjitha filloi kur inxhinieri Nazim, nje ish i dashuruar i lenduar, me nje zemer te arte, njihet ”online” me gruan e endrrave te tij, Nehir. Ata shkruheshin per muaj te tere duke u lidhur shume me njeri-tjetrin. Ne panik nje dite ai zgjedh nje portret simpatik duke e genjyer ate dhe ajo u dashurua me ate genjeshter...

programme.title: Të braktisurit
programme.desc: Kur jeta të merr gjithçka, mbetet vetëm forca për të luftuar. Një histori e jashtezakonshme për familjen, sakrificën dhe shpresën. Mes vështirësive dhe padrejtësive, ata kanë vetëm njëri-tjetrin. Një serial i mbushur me emocione të forta dhe momente të paharrueshme. Rrugëtimi emocionues i gjashtë fëmijëve jetimë që luftojnë për të mbetur bashkë në një botë që përpiqet t’i ndajë. Seriali qe ka prekur zemrat e miliona shikuesve dhe me i klikuari ne mediat sociale me disa aktore yje.

programme.title: Tradhtia
programme.desc: Ajo besoi tek dashuria dhe tek familja. Besoi se pas 30 vitesh martesë, e njihte njeriun që kishte në krah. Gyzide ka ndërtuar jetën e saj mbi drejtësinë. Por tani, drejtësinë do ta kërkojë brenda familjes së saj. Kur e vërteta del në dritë, asgjë nuk do të jetë më si më parë. A mund ta rindërtosh jetën pasi zbulon se gjithçka që besoje ishte një gënjeshtër? Vahide Perçin në një nga rolet më të fuqishme të karrierës së saj.

programme.title: Mashtruesit
programme.desc: Një dramë e mbushur me intriga, sekrete, dhe lojëra të rrezikshme, ku e vërteta dhe gënjeshtra ndërthuren në çdo hap. Ertan, një avokat i talentuar i cili së bashku me të atin, nuk heziton të përdorë metoda të pazakonta për të fituar çështjet e tyre dhe Asja, një grua që përballet me vështirësi të mëdha dhe detyrohet të përdorë zgjuarsinë dhe mashtrimin për të mbajtur familjen e saj. Sa më shumë zbulohen sekretet, aq më shumë bëhet e vështirë të dallosh se kush është viktimë, kush është mashtrue.

programme.title: Lajme
programme.desc: Lajme nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: STOP
programme.desc: Aktualiteti shqiptar ”alla Stop”, problematika e njerëzve të thjeshtë, që pasi kanë trokitur në të gjitha dyert, gjejnë zgjidhje vetëm në ”Stop” , video-kamera të fshehta, që denoncojnë e demaskojnë korrupsionin, dhunën apo abuzimin seksual. Akte humanizmi për më të pamundurit e fatkeqët, të cilëve u ndryshon jeta. Nje emision i gjithi vetëm për njerëzit e zakonshëm dhe me njerëzit në qendër.

programme.title: Gjeniu
programme.desc: Një gjeni i tradhëtuar nga njeriu që duhej ta mbronte. Mes sekreteve, pushtetit dhe lojërave të mendjes, fillon një betejë ku fiton vetëm më i zgjuari. Devran është një djalë me inteligjencë të jashtëzakonshme, jeta e të cilit ndryshon për shkak të tradhtisë së babait të tij. Një lojë të rrezikshme mendjesh, ku çdo lëvizje është e llogaritur dhe çdo aleancë mund të fshehë një tradhti. Ndërsa sekretet e së kaluarës dalin në dritë, Devrani duhet të zgjedhë mes hakmarrjes dhe njerëzve që do. Fitues.

programme.title: Opinion
programme.desc: Emisioni politik me i ndjekur dhe me i preferuar ne ekranet shqiptare nga Blendi Fevziu. Arena e politikes shqiptare qe prej 31 gushtit 1997. Komente, analiza, debate, personazhe, deshmi dhe fakte konkrete. Ngjarjet me te fundit dhe me te rendesishme...

programme.title: Karteli
programme.desc: Vellezerit qe krijuan perandorine me te madhe te krimit te organizuar ne Cali gjate viteve ’60 - ’70. Familja, romancat dhe ambicja e dy vellezerve per te mbreteruar industrine e droges ne Kolumbi. Vellezerit Villegas, te njohur ndryshe si ”Los Caballeros de Cali”, kriminelet me te kerkuar ne te gjithe boten... Historia e vertete se si ata u bene nga femije te varfer, ne boset e droges. Bazuar ne librin ”El cartel de los sapos” te Andres Lopez.
